title: Waves
statement: Fan-out runs as logged waves: one wave record, no more than eight file-disjoint claimed beads, one background agent per bead, and one item verdict each.
predicate: A worker seat with at least two claimable independent beads and zero live background agents for more than 15 minutes violates.

cases.name: comply
cases.event: a logged wave assigns at most eight file-disjoint beads and starts one agent per bead

cases.name: violate
cases.event: two claimable independent beads remain while the worker has zero live background agents for more than 15 minutes
